contexts.text: Those against whom he has clandestinely machinated are presented.
They who suppose that they can obtain all things by deceitful machinations... seem to themselves to dwell in an infernal tun...
For whatever they have... machinated against another stands forth.
They plotted against him to put him to death ()... To plot = to want from a depraved mind...
Evil Genii who from the love of self have secretly machinated evil against the neighbour...
They who by machinations, arts, and cunning have come to honours or riches, become magicians there...
(There) they machinate deceits...

This (tower) was a representative of their machinations; for in the Spiritual World machinations are presented to view to those who stand afar off by many things which do not actually come forth with those who are in the machinations.

The delights of their concupiscences together with their deceitful machinations are the more remote threads (of the spider's web), where the flies are caught... (That is, are the external of thought with them. Illustrated.)
When he sees that machinations, etc., succeed...
Such an exclamation is nothing else than a machination to cheat God...
They have nothing but machinations there.
Such things are machinated...
Machinatress of subtle deceits.
On the horrible... machinations of some interior Spirits.
They had wicked machinations...
How the Lord sees all the machinations...
(David) machinates without conscience.
They have most deceitfully machinated.
He eluded their magical machinations.
One Angel can see... all their machinations...
He always devised new machinations.
He began to weave machinations...
The preacher who... machinates evils of all kinds...
The machinators of iniquity ().
